{{Quote|Excuse me, but in case it wasn't obvious by the locked door you sliced through, this is a private docking bay.|Fabizan|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Fabizan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Merchant/Legends|salesman]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was preparing to meet with [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]] in the [[Coruscant Spaceport]]'s [[Docking Bay 87 (Coruscant)|Docking Bay 87]], but instead was met by [[Corso Riggs]] and [[Voidhound|the captain]] of the ship that was being Fabizan and his guards. After the smuggler and Riggs slew the guards, Fabizan explained that he was looking after the smuggler's ship while Skavak was looking for upgrades.<ref name="SWTOR" />
